I am much obliged for your kind letter & Congratulations. I am very glad to possess your photograph   I enclose one of myself made of me by one of my sons, for I have no other.

I am particularly glad that you have given me the reference to the comptes Rendus”, for the subject referred to interests me in an especial manner, & I have obtained very few authentic facts.

I am glad to hear that you are still working on the Cucurbitacæ; I have lately quoted extensively from your most interesting papers on this order, in a work which I am preparing on variation. I hope soon to send you a paper on Lythrum which I trust may interest you;

with Sincere thanks & respect | I remain dear Sir | yours faithfully & obliged | Charles Darwin
